import json,hashlib,resource,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'code'))
import classification_plane_cohiggs_kernel_pointwise as c
q=c.q
ROOT=Path.cwd()
JOB='research/classification/jobs/plane_cohiggs_nil_three_whole_walls.json'
OUTPUT='reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_COHIGGS_NIL_THREE_WHOLE_WALLS_20261108.json'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(175,180))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3*1024**3,3*1024**3))
started=time.monotonic()
job=json.loads((ROOT/JOB).read_text())
for x in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
packet=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_RANK_ZERO_FULLRANK_WEIGHTS_20261107.json').read_text())
record=next(x for x in packet['cases'] if x['type']=='nilpotent')
first,second=c.bases()
def addP(*Ps):return q.antisymmetric({ij:q.add(*(P.get(ij,{}) for P in Ps)) for ij in c.PAIRS})
def scaleP(P,p):return q.antisymmetric({ij:q.mul(p,P.get(ij,{})) for ij in c.PAIRS})
def row_polys(J):
    polys={}
    for quad,p in J.items():
        for ex,v in p.items():
            key=(quad,ex[:5]);param=ex[5:]
            polys.setdefault(key,{})[param]=v
    return [polys.get((quad,e),{}) for quad,e in q.ROWS]
def zero(poly,S):
    return {e:v for e,v in poly.items() if all(e[5+j]==0 for j in S)}
def zrow(poly,S):
    return {e:v for e,v in poly.items() if all(e[j]==0 for j in S)}
def coord_factor(Pf):
    if not Pf:return {'Pf_zero':True}
    e=[min(x[i] for x in Pf) for i in range(5)]+[0,0,0]
    if any(e):
        quotient={tuple(a-b for a,b in zip(x,e)):v for x,v in Pf.items()}
        assert q.mul({tuple(e):F(1)},quotient)==Pf
        return {'factor_exponents':e,'quotient':c.polynomial_records(quotient)}
    return None
def fixed_nonzero_coefficient(p):
    groups={}
    for e,v in p.items():groups.setdefault(e[:5],{})[e[5:]]=v
    return any(len(d)==1 and (0,0,0) in d and d[(0,0,0)] for d in groups.values())
def plane_bridges(P,Pf):
    found=[]
    for normal in combinations(range(5),2):
        def restrict(p):return {e:v for e,v in p.items() if not any(e[i] for i in normal)}
        if any(restrict(P.get((i,j),{})) for i in normal for j in range(5)):continue
        tangent=[i for i in range(5) if i not in normal];i,j,k=tangent
        R=restrict(q.add(q.mul(q.atom(1,i),P.get((j,k),{})),
                         q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,j),P.get((i,k),{})),-1),
                         q.mul(q.atom(1,k),P.get((i,j),{}))))
        if not R or not Pf:continue
        m=min(sum(e[i] for i in normal) for e in Pf)
        lead={e:v for e,v in Pf.items() if sum(e[i] for i in normal)==m}
        universal=bool(m in (3,4) and fixed_nonzero_coefficient(R) and fixed_nonzero_coefficient(lead))
        found.append({'normal_coordinate_indices':list(normal),'restriction_cubic':c.polynomial_records(R),
                      'minimum_normal_multiplicity':m,'leading_normal_symbol':c.polynomial_records(lead),
                      'ranktwo_cubic_and_exact_m_have_nonzero_constant_coefficients':universal,
                      'accepted_all_plane_m3_m4_bridge_applies_whole_face':universal})
    return found
def shear_inverse(P0,P,S,nparams):
    n=5+nparams+6;offset=5+nparams;x=[c.atom_n(index=i,n=n) for i in range(n)]
    G=list(x);H=list(x)
    for i in range(3):
        d=q.add(q.mul(x[offset+i],x[3]),q.mul(x[offset+3+i],x[4]))
        G[i]=q.add(x[i],d);H[i]=q.add(x[i],q.scale(d,-1))
    assert [c.subst(p,H) for p in G]==x and [c.subst(p,G) for p in H]==x
    base={ij:c.lift(p,n) for ij,p in P0.items()};pushed=c.push(base,G,H);res={}
    for ij in c.PAIRS:
        W1={e:v for e,v in q.add(pushed.get(ij,{}),q.scale(base.get(ij,{}),-1)).items()
            if e[3]+e[4]-sum(i>=3 for i in ij)==1}
        expected=q.add(*(q.mul(x[offset+j],c.lift(c.tensor_linear(first,[S[i][j] for i in range(30)]).get(ij,{}),n)) for j in range(6)))
        res[ij]=q.add(W1,q.scale(expected,-1))
    for i,j,k in combinations(range(5),3):
        assert not q.add(q.mul(x[i],res[j,k]),q.scale(q.mul(x[j],res[i,k]),-1),q.mul(x[k],res[i,j]))
    whole={ij:c.lift(p,n) for ij,p in P.items()}
    back=c.push(c.push(whole,G,H),H,G)
    assert all(back.get(ij,{})==whole.get(ij,{}) for ij in c.PAIRS)
    return {'all_six_parameters_and_polynomial_inverse':True,
            'saved_S_full_Euler_quotient_identity':True,'full150_roundtrip_all_remaining_parameters':True}
results=[]
for tau in (F(-3,2),F(1,2),F(3,2)):
    wall=next(x for x in record['all_exceptional_roots'] if F(x['tau'])==tau)
    C1,C2,CS=wall['D1'],wall['D2'],wall['actual_shear']
    K=c.mat(C1['complete_kernel'],tau);S=c.mat(record['complete_actual_shear_30_by6'],tau)
    sc=CS['minor_columns'];rr=CS['minor_rows'];rankS=CS['rank']
    Sb=[[row[j] for j in sc] for row in S]
    A=q.matmul(q.inverse([Sb[i] for i in rr]),[K[i] for i in rr])
    d=C1['nullity'];R=[[K[i][j]-sum(Sb[i][k]*A[k][j] for k in range(rankS)) for j in range(d)] for i in range(30)]
    normals=[];B=[];left=[row[:] for row in R]
    for _ in range(d-rankS):
        j=next(j for j in range(d) if any(row[j] for row in left));p=next(i for i in range(30) if left[i][j])
        N=[row[j]/left[p][j] for row in left];b=left[p][:]
        normals.append(N);B.append(b)
        left=[[left[i][j]-N[i]*b[j] for j in range(d)] for i in range(30)]
    assert not any(v for row in left for v in row) and len(normals) in (1,2)
    assert all(not N[i] for N in normals for i in rr)
    nN=len(normals);free=C2['nullity'];nparams=nN+free
    assert nparams<=3 and (free==1 if tau==F(1,2) else free==0)
    D2=c.mat(record['complete_D2_350_by9'],tau);rk=C2['rank'];DR,DC=C2['minor_rows'],C2['minor_columns']
    inv=q.inverse([[D2[i][j] for j in DC] for i in DR])
    D2ker=c.mat(C2['complete_kernel'],tau)
    P0=c.constant_tensor(record['normal_form_P0'],tau);N=[c.tensor_linear(first,z) for z in normals]
    V=[q.atom(1,5+i) for i in range(nparams)]
    P1=addP(*(scaleP(N[i],V[i]) for i in range(nN)))
    J1=row_polys(q.jacobi(P1))
    # Solve every quadratic forcing coefficient with precisely the old selected D2 inverse.
    monomials=sorted({e for row in J1 for e in row})
    P2coords=[{} for _ in range(9)]
    for e in monomials:
        rhs=[J1[i].get(e,F(0)) for i in DR]
        sol=[-sum(inv[i][j]*rhs[j] for j in range(rk)) for i in range(rk)]
        for col,value in zip(DC,sol):
            if value:P2coords[col][(0,)*5+e]=value
    for k in range(free):
        for i in range(9):P2coords[i]=q.add(P2coords[i],q.scale(V[nN+k],D2ker[i][k]))
    P2=addP(*(scaleP(second[i],P2coords[i]) for i in range(9)))
    curve=addP(P0,P1,P2);J=q.jacobi(curve);rows=row_polys(J)
    assert all(sum(e)<=4 and all(e[j]==0 for j in range(nparams,3)) for row in rows for e in row)
    assert all(sum(e)>=2 for row in rows for e in row)
    Pf=c.divisor(curve)
    # At most eight coordinate-zero faces; only original single-monomial rows give the cover.
    monomial_rows=[(i,next(iter(row))) for i,row in enumerate(rows) if len(row)==1]
    faces=[]
    for mask in range(1<<nparams):
        Z={i for i in range(nparams) if mask>>i&1}
        if not all(any(e[i] for i in Z) for _,e in monomial_rows):continue
        if any(set(x['zero_parameters']).issubset(Z) for x in faces):continue
        restrictedPf=zero(Pf,Z);restrictedP={ij:zero(p,Z) for ij,p in curve.items()}
        fc=coord_factor(restrictedPf)
        depends=sorted({i for e in restrictedPf for i in range(5) if e[i]})
        planes=plane_bridges(restrictedP,restrictedPf)
        if fc:conclusion='EMPTY_by_actual_factor_or_zero'
        elif len(depends)<=3:conclusion='KNOWN_essential_three_eight_component_union'
        elif any(x['accepted_all_plane_m3_m4_bridge_applies_whole_face'] for x in planes):conclusion='KNOWN_all_ranktwo_plane_m3_m4_union'
        else:conclusion='UNRESOLVED_exact_whole_parameter_face'
        faces.append({'zero_parameters':sorted(Z),'actual_factor_or_Pfzero':fc,
                      'spatial_variables_in_actual_Pf':depends,
                      'second_coordinate_Poisson_planes':planes,
                      'whole_face_conclusion':conclusion})
    results.append({'tau':str(tau),'old_kernel_dim':d,'old_actual_shear_rank':rankS,
                    'old_D2_rank':rk,'old_D2_free_kernel_retained':free,'residual_normal_count':nN,
                    'same_saved_Sminor_rows':rr,'same_saved_Sminor_columns':sc,
                    'same_saved_D2minor_rows':DR,'same_saved_D2minor_columns':DC,
                    'K_equals_SbasisA_plus_NB_all30_rows':True,
                    'A':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in A],'B':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in B],
                    'P0':c.tensor_records(P0),'normal_tensors':[c.tensor_records(z) for z in N],
                    'P2_all_nine_parameter_polynomials':[c.polynomial_records(z) for z in P2coords],
                    'whole_curve':c.tensor_records(curve),
                    'full350_original_row_polynomials':[{','.join(map(str,e)):str(v) for e,v in row.items()} for row in rows],
                    'full350_row_labels':[{'quad':list(a),'monomial':list(b)} for a,b in q.ROWS],
                    'all126_actual_Pf_parameter_polynomials':c.polynomial_records(Pf),
                    'original_single_monomial_rows':[{'row':i,'exponents':list(e),'coefficient':str(rows[i][e])} for i,e in monomial_rows],
                    'complete_coordinate_face_cover':faces,
                    'all_faces_closed':all('UNRESOLVED' not in f['whole_face_conclusion'] for f in faces),
                    'actual_finite_shear_inverse':shear_inverse(P0,curve,S,nparams)})
out=ROOT/OUTPUT;assert not out.exists()
res={'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','status':'ONE_remaining_three_whole_nil_wall_batch_completed',
     'all_explicit_identity_checks_passed':True,'all_three_whole_sources_closed':all(x['all_faces_closed'] for x in results),
     'cases':results,'no_new_M1_rank_minor_point_GB_or_jet':True,
     'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
     'inputs':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],'inline_caller_source':job['inline_caller_source'],
     'inline_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(job['inline_caller_source'].encode()).hexdigest(),
     'main_frontier_oldcode_oldreports_globals_unchanged':True}
out.write_text(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for x in results:print(x['tau'],[(f['zero_parameters'],f['whole_face_conclusion']) for f in x['complete_coordinate_face_cover']],flush=True)
print('PASS explicit identities',res['seconds'],res['maximum_RSS_KiB'],flush=True)
